anomalies.found_by: EX-2 runner, diagnosed by EX-2 auditor (notes/EX-2_audit.md)
anomalies.what: stale_dd is identically 0.0 across all 4778 non-null panel rows. Guard G4 is satisfied VACUOUSLY, and the G1 assertion for stale_dd (set(unique) subset of {0,1}) passes trivially on an all-zeros column.
anomalies.why: cmd_build requires exact 4-way float equality of call_bid, call_ask, put_bid, put_ask vs the prior session at the same strike. Auditor measured the true rates read-only on canonical_liquid chains (518,008 contract-days, ATM +/-2%): per-leg unchanged 1.07%, >=1 leg 3.37%, all four 0.019%. Expected firings over 4,778 rows = ~0.9. The detector is not broken; it is too strict by roughly two orders of magnitude.
anomalies.impact: A 0/4778 reading is equally consistent with 'no staleness' and 'fires once per 5,000 rows'. EX-3 is untestable as the panel stands. G1 has a coverage hole: an assertion that a column is binary is satisfied by a constant column.

anomalies.what: EX-5 ('which lead maximises paired NET') is arithmetically closed, not an independent experiment.
anomalies.why: cmd_build computes exit_mid and exit_date ONCE per event, outside the lead loop (verified: 0 of 967 events have more than one distinct exit_mid). Therefore gross_a - gross_b = exit_mid*(mid_b - mid_a)/(mid_a*mid_b) is a deterministic function of the entry mids EX-2 already published, and paired net is fully determined by entry_mid and entry_spread at the two leads.
anomalies.impact: This is a TRUE property of the trade (both leads exit at the same pre-print mark), not a build bug. But it means EX-5 spends no alpha and provides no new evidence: choosing a lead on net is a calculation, not an experiment. Protocol lesson: some execution questions are arithmetic, and the pipeline must recognise them rather than paying alpha for them.
anomalies.status: EX-5 RE-SCOPED to a deterministic calculation. Removed from the alpha-spending queue.

anomalies.what: Entry weekday is near-collinear with lead bucket, and nominal lead labels misstate realised leads.
anomalies.why: ann-7 and ann-14 land on the announcement's own weekday; ann-3/5/10 are ~65% Friday. Realised mean leads are 3.98/5.43/7.03/11.01/14.05, so real step sizes are 1.45/1.60/3.98/3.04 days rather than the nominal 2/2/3/4.
anomalies.impact: Produced the false T-10 finding (now POLICY P7, REFUTED) and the false convexity claim (withdrawn). Any future lead comparison MUST hold announcement weekday fixed.
anomalies.status: RECORDED. Encoded as POLICY standing limitation 2 and as new hypothesis EX-7.

anomalies.what: The cost gradient's mechanism is the reverse of the runner's reading.
anomalies.why: Within-event decomposition: sqrt(dte) x1.558, spread x1.389, IV level x0.731, IV width x0.850, giving cost_frac x1.162 exactly. Vega-normalised, the quote is WIDER near the print (paired +0.0018, p=0.0005).

proposed_amendments.rationale: ANOM-1. A staleness detector that fires ~0.9 times per panel provides no protection, and a semantics assertion that a constant column satisfies provides no guard.
proposed_amendments.sketch: (a) replace 4-way exact equality with a graded n_unchanged_legs in {0..4}; (b) add economic staleness - option mid or IV unchanged WHILE spot moved; (c) add book-quality flags: zero/absent bid, crossed or locked quote, spread vs the contract's own trailing median; (d) strengthen G1 to reject DEGENERATE columns (require nunique() > 1), not only out-of-domain ones.
proposed_amendments.requires: researcher approval; panel rebuild; new panel hash; re-verification of semantics; harness re-freeze with the new sha256 recorded here
proposed_amendments.status: AWAITING RESEARCHER APPROVAL. Amendments are legitimate only BETWEEN ticks and never in response to a result. EX-3 stays BLOCKED until resolved.
